activity.notes: Philip IV of France, called Philip the Fair, was king of France from 1285 to 1314. ATLAS records only this French royal reign and keeps him distinct from the separately existing Philip IV of Spain.

sources.title: Fitzwilliam Museum — Leaves from Laurent d’Orléans, La Somme le roi
sources.citation_text: The Fitzwilliam Museum identifies Philip IV of France with the royal dates 1285–1314 in its discussion of a manuscript likely made for Philip IV and Jeanne of Navarre.
